name: Gosh Is Launcher
description:
A compact launcher for GNOME Shell with interchangeable looks (Spotlight, Omarchy/Walker, Pop!_OS COSMIC, Ulauncher, KRunner, GNOME, Rofi, Raycast, Albert, Wofi, Fuzzel, Anyrun, Tofi, Light).

Features:
* Instant app search using GNOME-style matching - prefix, word-prefix, substring, GenericName, and Keywords
* Apps ranked by match quality and usage frequency, filtered by parental controls
* Open window switcher
* Recent files
* URL opener
* Path opener (~/ ./ and absolute paths)
* Optional command runner (! prefix)
* Prefix modes (= calc, @ web, # settings, $ windows, . files, ! command)
* Inline calculator (type '12 * 8 + 3' or '=2^8', press Enter to copy result to clipboard)
* System actions (lock, suspend, restart, shut down, log out, switch user, screenshot)
* GNOME Settings panels search
* Web search fallback (Google / DuckDuckGo / Brave / Bing / Startpage / Ecosia / Qwant / Kagi / Wikipedia)
* Enable or disable every provider from preferences
* Always opens on the primary monitor, centered or top-anchored
* Click outside or press Esc to close

CLIPBOARD ACCESS: This extension writes to the clipboard ONLY when the user explicitly selects a calculator result (presses Enter on a math expression). No clipboard data is read or transmitted to any third party. This is a user-initiated action, not background access.

Open with Ctrl+Space (set in preferences).
